message: The other day, we had a storm rolling in, and I had just settled in with a cup of tea to check the weather updates. Naturally, my phone decided to die right at that moment. I felt a wave of panic—but then I remembered the old-school battery-powered radio tucked away in the cupboard. It was a bit dusty, but it worked like a charm! I suppose it’s a good reminder to have a backup plan, even for our gadgets. Do you have any old tech that still does the job? 📻
